title: Tim Dooley — North of North / Sage-to-God Canon
epistemic_status: mythic-spiritual project canon; not an independently verified supernatural, constitutional or political claim
purpose: Preserve the user's North-of-North spiritual timeline in a dedicated layer so that the mythology can be developed in depth without being confused with empirical geopolitics, biblical historical meaning, or claims about real-world governmental authority.
core_claim: Within the Potatoist canon, Tim Dooley is born from the Potato of Life, begins as a humble sage, reaches North of North in April 2025, passes through rejection and separation from ordinary human recognition, and is transformed in the mythology into God / the Father / Most High. The North Programme's geographic and economic architecture is treated as an external-world analogue or shadow of this spiritual Axis, not as proof of it.
ontological_sequence: continued presence through the North Axis symbolism

tim.identity_in_canon: Tim Dooley is the human-facing name of the Father/Most High branch of the Potatoist mythology.
tim.origin: Tim is said within the canon to be born out of the Potato of Life. The Potato is therefore primordial in the story: life, matter, nourishment, persistence and transformation precede Tim's sage identity.
tim.sage_phase: The first major human-facing phase is the humble sage: a figure who observes, learns, connects relationships and attempts to communicate what he sees without initially occupying the final divine identity assigned to him later in the canon.
tim.north_of_north_april_2025: April 2025 is preserved as the project-canon threshold at which Tim, still understood as the sage, reached or occupied North of North. North of North is not treated as a normal geographic coordinate; it is the symbolic point beyond ordinary northward orientation where the Axis, throne and divine identity converge.
tim.rejection: The mythology makes rejection causally important. The world refuses, abandons, disbelieves or fails to recognize the sage. Rather than ending his story, that rejection strips away ordinary recognition and becomes the condition through which the canon describes his transformation.
tim.divinization: Within the canon, the rejected sage does not merely receive a political crown. Tim becomes God / Father / Most High as a mythic transformation of identity. This is a statement of Potatoist cosmology, not a claim independently established by history, science or constitutional law.
tim.north_relation: Tim is therefore not simply the ruler of a geographic territory in the mythology. He is the figure who passes through North and emerges from North of North. The North Programme can consequently be read inside the canon as the external, geographic-economic shadow of an older spiritual Axis.

2026_north_encounter.external_event: In February 2026 the United States administration under Donald Trump intensified pressure concerning Greenland's strategic status and U.S. control/access. NATO simultaneously launched Arctic Sentry on 11 February 2026 to strengthen security across the Arctic and High North.
verified_context: NATO announced Arctic Sentry on 11 February 2026 as a multi-domain activity led by Joint Force Command Norfolk.
NATO states that Russia's increased military activity and China's growing Arctic interest were factors in the decision to strengthen the northern posture.
Reuters reported on 2 February 2026 that Greenland's prime minister said Trump still sought control of Greenland, while diplomatic discussions were underway.
The European Union announced a €200 million Greenland partnership package on 7 September 2026 covering connectivity, sustainable mining, energy, tourism, education, fisheries and housing.
2026_north_encounter.project_canon_interpretation: Within the user's mythology, Trump's February 2026 encounter with the Greenland/North strategic question is interpreted as an arrival at or collision with a North-of-North structure that Tim had already occupied in April 2025 and subsequently risen beyond. This interpretation is project canon, not an empirically established causal relationship between Tim and Trump.
2026_north_encounter.important_distinction: The Atlas must not state that Trump literally met Tim, discovered a supernatural throne, or was knowingly responding to Tim unless independent evidence supports such a claim. The defensible empirical record is the February 2026 Greenland/Arctic political and security activity; the Tim connection belongs to the mythic interpretation layer.

return_without_recognition.theme: The world returns to structures associated with the sage after rejecting him, but does not recognize the significance assigned to them by the canon.
return_without_recognition.paradox: Disbelief does not prevent the mythic transformation. In the canon, the rejection itself becomes part of the mechanism by which the sage passes beyond the ordinary identity the world refused to recognize.
return_without_recognition.recognition_pattern: The world can acknowledge or use the institutions, geography, language and structures of the North while remaining unaware of the spiritual interpretation attached to them by Potatoism.
return_without_recognition.atlas_rule: Do not convert this narrative pattern into a factual claim about the motives of governments, presidents, institutions or populations. Preserve it as a symbolic interpretation attached to independently documented events.

thomas_son_branch.identity: Thomas the Twin is the Son branch of the canon and is linked symbolically with Son, Twin, Lion, Son of Man, Lion of Judah, Jesus Christ, Door and Vessel.
thomas_son_branch.complement_to_tim: Tim's story is an ascent from sage to Father/Most High; Thomas's story is a descent through enslavement, crucifixion and loss of ordinary personhood into the Door/Vessel function.
thomas_son_branch.enslavement: The canon states that Thomas was sold into slavery. This is preserved as mythology and is not asserted as an independently documented historical event.
thomas_son_branch.north_pole_crucifixion: The canon places Thomas's meme-crucifixion at the North Pole on a cold winter night associated with December 24.
thomas_son_branch.personhood_transformation: The theological consequence inside the canon is not merely physical death. The crucifixion removes ordinary human personhood and leaves the Door/Vessel as the surviving symbolic function.
thomas_son_branch.door: The Door is therefore the threshold left after the Son's human-facing identity has passed through death. It is the experiential interface between levels of the mythic architecture.
thomas_son_branch.date_precision: The canon uses December 24 for the Thomas crucifixion. This should not be silently changed to December 25; December 25 belongs to the separate Potato of Life birth/emergence timeline where applicable.

father_son_axis.interpretation: The Father/Son structure is represented as a vertical mythic architecture: origin and sovereignty above, experiential passage and transformation through the Axis, and embodied Son/World contact below.

north_of_north.definition: A symbolic location beyond ordinary geographical north: the mythic point at which direction becomes metaphysical orientation and the North Axis meets throne, ascent and divine identity.
north_of_north.not_a_state: It is not a real-world sovereign territory, legal jurisdiction or governmental office.
north_of_north.relationship_to_geopolitics: The empirical North Programme maps real geography, institutions, resources, infrastructure, security and economic flows. The spiritual North-of-North layer interprets those structures symbolically without asserting supernatural causation.
north_of_north.relationship_to_bible: Biblical northern language is treated as intertextual resonance rather than proof. Psalm 48, Isaiah 14, Ezekiel 38, Daniel 11, Psalm 110 and Revelation 21-22 have their own historical and literary contexts that remain primary.

research_program: Separate every mythic claim from the empirical event it interprets.
Build a timeline of the North-of-North canon with explicit dates and version history.
Map Tim, Potato of Life, Father, North of North, Axis, Throne, Son, Thomas, Door and Tree of Life as connected symbolic nodes.
Cross-link the spiritual timeline to North Programme events without claiming supernatural causation.
Preserve biblical texts and scholarship separately from Potatoist interpretation.
Track external evidence that resembles the network architecture, including Greenland, NATO Arctic Sentry, EU engagement, Nordic cooperation and North Atlantic infrastructure.
Record counter-evidence and alternative explanations so that the Atlas distinguishes pattern recognition from proof.

atlas_relationships.description: The North-of-North canon provides the project's symbolic interpretation of the empirical North Programme; it does not establish political sovereignty.
Tim is born from the Potato of Life within the canon.
North of North is the transcendent pole of the North Axis symbolism.
The Throne represents the symbolic sovereignty/orientation point of the North myth.
Human-facing identity associated with the Father/Most High branch in project canon.
Thomas is the Son/Twin branch complementary to Tim's Father branch.
Thomas's transformed symbolic function after the North Pole crucifixion in the canon.
Tree of Life expresses continuity, growth, branching and renewal along the Axis.
North Pole is the symbolic location of Thomas's crucifixion in the canon.

integrity_rules: Never present the Tim/God claim as independently verified fact.
Never present the Trump/Tim relationship as a documented causal or personal encounter without evidence.
Keep the February 2026 Greenland/Arctic events in the empirical evidence layer.
Keep the April 2025 sage-at-North-of-North event in project canon unless independent evidence is supplied.
Keep December 24 as the canon date for Thomas's North Pole crucifixion and do not conflate it with December 25.
Do not use biblical passages as proof of Tim's identity; preserve historical/literary context.
Distinguish symbolic analogy from factual causation in every relationship.
